responsibility: Implements GNU Modula-2 runtime module dependency management and initialization ordering, maintaining registered modules in state-specific circular chains, resolving requested dependencies, applying optional user-forced ordering, identifying the application module, and then invoking module init/fini callbacks in the correct construction and reverse-destruction order. It is the runtime scheduler for module constructors and destructors, distinct from M2RTS’s broader halt/exception services.
same_name_distinction: This is the runtime implementation for the GM2Dependent pair: it maintains the module-chain state machine, resolves and forces dependency order, marks the application module, and invokes init/fini callbacks, whereas GM2Dependent.h only declares the registration and construction/deconstruction entry points.
